```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(psych)
library(stats)
library(purrr)
library(multicon)
library(Hmisc)
library(lavaan)
library(fastDummies)

############READ DATA: PreliminaryStudy, Study1, Study2
```

#Model Specifications
X=NativeIdentity
M1=RecognitionOfOmission
M2=PerceivedRacism
Y=CivicEngagement or HighCommitmentHighRiskEngagement

```{r}
#serial mediation 



M.serial.0<-'
#path
M1~a1*X
M2~a2*X+d*M1
Y~b2*M2+b1*M1+cp*X


#effect
ie1:=a1*b1
ie2:=a2*b2
ie3:=a1*d*b2
de:= cp
'

#parallel, no covariate
M.para<- '
Y~b1*M1 + b2*M2 + c*X 
M1~a1*X 
M2~ a2*X 

#Indirect
indirect1:= a1*b1
indirect2:=a2*b2

#Direct
direct:=c

#Total
total:=c + (a1*b1) + (a2*b2)

#covariates
M1~~M2
'

```

#Preliminary Study
##main model
```{r}
####standardized coefficients
#model data frame
df.std<-data.frame(scale(PreliminaryStudy$NativeIdentity), scale(PreliminaryStudy$RecognitionOfOmission),scale(PreliminaryStudy$PerceivedRacism),scale(PreliminaryStudy$CivicEngagement)) #data frame

names(df.std)<-c("X","M1","M2","Y")

df.std<-df.std %>% 
  drop_na()

#total effect
m0<-lm(Y~X,data=df.std)
summary(m0)
confint(m0)


fit.std<-sem(M.serial.0, data=df.std,se="bootstrap",bootstrap=5000)
summary(fit.std, fit.measures = TRUE,
        standardize = TRUE,
        rsquare = TRUE)
parameterEstimates(fit.std,
                   boot.ci.type = "bca.simple",
                   level = .95,
                   ci = TRUE,
                   standardized = FALSE)
```

##order effect
###0=omission first; 1=discrimination first


```{r}
#order effect
t.test(PreliminaryStudy$RecognitionOfOmission~PreliminaryStudy$order)
t.test(PreliminaryStudy$PerceivedRacism~PreliminaryStudy$order)

#omission first
PreliminaryStudy.omission<-PreliminaryStudy %>% filter(order==0)
df.std.omission<-data.frame(scale(PreliminaryStudy.omission$NativeIdentity), scale(PreliminaryStudy.omission$RecognitionOfOmission),scale(PreliminaryStudy.omission$PerceivedRacism),scale(PreliminaryStudy.omission$CivicEngagement)) #data frame

names(df.std.omission)<-c("X","M1","M2","Y")

df.std.omission<-df.std.omission %>% 
  drop_na()

#total effect
m0<-lm(Y~X,data=df.std.omission)
summary(m0)
confint(m0)


fit.std.omission<-sem(M.serial.0, data=df.std.omission,se="bootstrap",bootstrap=5000)
parameterEstimates(fit.std.omission,
                   boot.ci.type = "bca.simple",
                   level = .95,
                   ci = TRUE,
                   standardized = FALSE)

#discrimination first
PreliminaryStudy.discrimination<-PreliminaryStudy %>% filter(order==1)
df.std.discrimination<-data.frame(scale(PreliminaryStudy.discrimination$NativeIdentity), scale(PreliminaryStudy.discrimination$RecognitionOfOmission),scale(PreliminaryStudy.discrimination$PerceivedRacism),scale(PreliminaryStudy.discrimination$CivicEngagement)) #data frame

names(df.std.discrimination)<-c("X","M1","M2","Y")

df.std.discrimination<-df.std.discrimination %>% 
  drop_na()

#total effect
m0<-lm(Y~X,data=df.std.discrimination)
summary(m0)
confint(m0)


fit.std.discrimination<-sem(M.serial.0, data=df.std.discrimination,se="bootstrap",bootstrap=5000)
parameterEstimates(fit.std.discrimination,
                   boot.ci.type = "bca.simple",
                   level = .95,
                   ci = TRUE,
                   standardized = FALSE)

```

#total effect
m0<-lm(Y~X,data=df.std)
summary(m0)
confint(m0)


fit.std<-sem(M.serial.0, data=df.std,se="bootstrap",bootstrap=5000)
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE,
        standardize = TRUE,
        rsquare = TRUE)
parameterEstimates(fit.std,
                   boot.ci.type = "bca.simple",
                   level = .95,
                   ci = TRUE,
                   standardized = FALSE)
